attributes.text: Day. Walk only as far as your rehab team allowed, on flat ground. You should still be able to speak in short sentences. Chest discomfort means stop and sit. If the doctor asked you to watch fluid, weigh yourself in the morning: same scale, shoes off. About two kilos gained in two or three days, new ankle swelling, or needing more pillows to breathe is a call-the-doctor day.

Tell the doctor. Not later: pressure in the chest, pain into the arm, neck, or jaw, cold sweat, nausea with that pressure, or breath you cannot catch. Open Help and call. Chew an aspirin only if your own doctor already told you to do that for chest pain. Asha will not invent that dose. Also report dizziness on a new tablet, a new cough after a new medicine, or a pulse that feels very slow.
A short summary of two weeks: medicines taken, sugar, blood pressure and pain. Send it before a visit.
